<!-- generated by npm run docs:generate; do not edit -->

Admin routes of the currencies module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/currencies

List currencies with enabled/default flags

Responses:

- `200`: Currencies retrieved.

## PATCH /v1/admin/currencies

Bulk update enabled currencies + default

Request body: [UpdateEnabledCurrenciesDto](#updateenabledcurrenciesdto).

Responses:

- `200`: Updated.
- `400`: Empty enabled list or default not in enabled set.

## GET /v1/admin/currencies/store

Store display currency + enabled set (any staff role)

Responses:

- `200`: Store currency retrieved.
- `403`: Customer session — not a staff role.

## Schemas

### UpdateEnabledCurrenciesDto

- `enabled` (`"TND"`, `"LYD"`, `"QAR"`, `"AED"`, `"SAR"`, `"KWD"`, `"BHD"`, `"OMR"`, `"EGP"`, `"JOD"`, `"EUR"`, `"GBP"`, `"CHF"`, `"SEK"`, `"USD"`, `"CAD"`, `"MXN"`, `"BRL"`, `"JPY"`, `"CNY"`, `"INR"`, `"SGD"`, `"AUD"`, required).
- `defaultCode` (`"TND"`, `"LYD"`, `"QAR"`, `"AED"`, `"SAR"`, `"KWD"`, `"BHD"`, `"OMR"`, `"EGP"`, `"JOD"`, `"EUR"`, `"GBP"`, `"CHF"`, `"SEK"`, `"USD"`, `"CAD"`, `"MXN"`, `"BRL"`, `"JPY"`, `"CNY"`, `"INR"`, `"SGD"`, `"AUD"`, optional).
